known_limitations: WP-005 specifies the architecture and tests for independent Path B; it does not prove independence of an implementation that has not yet been built and audited.
Using another language is preferred but not sufficient; physical packet isolation and dynamic access tracing remain mandatory.
Declarative policy tables may be shared only after review confirms they are specification data rather than copied production executable semantics.
Semantic similarity scanning thresholds for copied-code detection must be frozen by the future dependency auditor and may produce false positives requiring outcome-blind review.

The repository validate_oracle_boundary.py is currently an artifact-level wrapper; producer used deterministic YAML and cross-file audits, and the independent reviewer must decide whether to require a dedicated semantic validator.
unexpected_findings: A separate package name or programming language does not establish independence if the production tree, caches or generated frames remain mounted.
Negative dependency controls are necessary to prove the auditor detects forbidden behavior rather than merely passing a clean candidate.
Gold governance and acceptable-alternative freeze are part of oracle independence, not only annotation procedure.
